8.6.2 Optional Interfaces
This chapter defines all interfaces required to fulfill an optional functionality of the mod-
ule.

communication (frame shall be handled by switch
according to the common address resolution
behavior) and stores the information for processing
of EthSwt_EthTxFinishedIndication().

Ethernet frame.
